title: Digital arrest: FD broken, then a transfer during a long video call
story: A 'CBI officer' on a WhatsApp video call for 95 minutes says her Aadhaar is linked to a money-laundering parcel. She breaks her fixed deposit and is told to move the money to an 'RBI verification account'.
why: A first payment far above anything she has ever sent (₹287 usual), to an account in a flagged mule network, 3 hours after breaking an FD, during a 95-minute internet call from an unknown number. Every family should agree.
